blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-context language models support ever longer context windows, and evaluations typically treat context length as the main indicator of difficulty. However, context length alone cannot explain why models fail on long-context tasks that require reasoning over complex information. Contexts of equal length can pose very different challenges: a task may be solvable from a single local passage, or it may require integrating evidence distributed across the full context. We quantitatively characterise this difficulty through three properties: evidence scope, how much necessary information must be found; evidence dispersion, how widely that information is scattered within the context; and reasoning depth, how many dependent steps are needed to derive an answer from it. We construct LURCH, a multi-domain question-answering benchmark of 6,550 instances with supporting evidence and reasoning graphs, enabling all three properties to be quantified. Evaluations of proprietary and open-weight models show that: (1) at fixed context length, all our three properties are strongly negatively correlated with model performance; (2) as context length increases, performance degrades sharply on samples with dispersed evidence, whereas it remains relatively stable on samples with localised evidence; and (3) difficulty compounds across properties, as questions with moderately high values on all three are harder than those with an extreme value on just one. These findings establish evidence scope, dispersion and reasoning depth as measures of long-context reasoning difficulty that complement context length.
blocks.zh: 长文本语言模型支持更长的上下文窗口,评价通常将上下文长度作为困难的主要指标. 然而,仅凭上下文长度无法解释模型为何在需要对复杂信息进行推理的长文任务上失败. 相同长度的背景可构成非常不同的挑战:一项任务可能从一个单一的局部通道中解脱出来,或可能需要综合整个背景中分发的证据。 我们通过三个特性从数量上描述这一困难:证据范围,必须找到多少必要的信息;证据分散,信息在上下文中分散的程度;推理深度,从中得出答案需要多少依附步骤. 我们构建了LURCH,这是一个由6 550个实例组成的多领域问答基准,并附有辅助证据和推理图表,使所有三个属性都能量化。 对专有和开重模型的评价表明:(1) 在固定上下文长度下,我们三个属性都与模型性能有很强的负相关;(2) 随着上下文长度的增加,性能在有分散证据的样本上急剧下降,而在有本地证据的样本上则保持相对稳定;(3) 跨属性的难度复合物,因为所有三个具有中度高值的问题都比仅一个具有极端价值的问题更困难. 这些结论确定了证据范围、分散和推理深度,作为对上下文长度加以补充的长期文字推理困难的衡量。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) can now process hundreds of thousands or even millions of tokens enabling applications involving books, scientific papers, financial reports, and long conversation histories ( Team et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Singh et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . However, the ability to accommodate long inputs does not guarantee effective reasoning over them: models struggle to use information located in the middle of the context ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , and their effective context length often falls well short of the claimed window ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) . Existing evaluations typically treat context length as the main indicator of difficulty, assessing models on the same tasks at different input lengths ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . While this approach reveals how performance changes with length, it leaves open which properties beyond token count make long-context reasoning difficult.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)现在可以处理数十万甚至数百万个令牌,使涉及书籍、科学论文、财务报告和长对话历史的应用成为可能(Team等,2023;Yang等,2025;Singh等,2025;Xu等,2026)。 然而,容纳长篇投入的能力并不能保证有效的推理:模型在使用位于上下文中间的信息上挣扎(Liu等,2024b),其有效上下文长度往往远远低于所主张的窗口(Hsieh等,2024). 现有评价通常将上下文长度作为困难的主要指标,对不同输入长度的相同任务的模型进行评估(Hsieh等,2024;Lu等,2026;Li等,2026a)。 虽然这种方法揭示了性能如何随长度而变化,但除了记号之外,还留下了哪些属性使得长文推理变得困难.

blocks.en: Long-context benchmarks have increasingly moved from testing whether models can retrieve information to testing whether they can reason over it, covering multi-document, domain-specific, and aggregation-heavy tasks ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Reddy et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Yet these benchmarks mainly reveal where models fail, rather than what makes individual instances difficult. Goldman et al. (2024) take an important step by conceptualising two dimensions of long-context difficulty: scope (“How much necessary information is there to find?”) and dispersion (“How hard is it to find them in the context?”). These concepts help explain why questions of similar length may impose different demands on a model, but they are defined qualitatively rather than as measurable quantities. ETHIC ( Lee et al., 2025 ) quantifies information coverage, but relies on an evaluator model’s judgements of which context chunks are potentially necessary, and captures only one aspect of difficulty in a limited range of task settings. Without quantitative definitions, it is difficult to establish how these properties vary across tasks, how they relate to model performance, and whether they account for differences in difficulty beyond context length.
blocks.zh: 长文本基准从测试模型能否检索信息到测试是否能够解释,涵盖多文件、特定领域和集成重活(Wang等,2024;Reddy等,2024;Bai等,2025;Li等,2026a). 然而,这些基准主要揭示了模式失败之处,而不是使个别情况变得困难的原因。 Goldman等人(2024年)采取了重要步骤,构思了长文难度的两个层面:范围 (“需要找到多少必要信息?”)和分散(“在上下文中找到信息有多难?” )。 这些概念有助于解释为何长度相近的问题可能对模型提出不同要求,但它们被定性地界定,而不是可计量的数量。 ETHIC(Lee等,2025年)对信息覆盖面进行了量化,但依赖于一个评价模型对哪些上下文块可能是必要的判断,在有限的任务环境中只抓住了困难的一个方面。 没有定量定义,就很难确定这些属性如何因任务而异,它们与模型性能的关系如何,它们是否考虑到超出上下文长度的困难差异.

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose quantitative definitions of evidence scope and evidence dispersion , based on the amount and positions of the supporting evidence within the context. We further extend this characterisation with reasoning depth , defined as the longest dependency path in an evidence-to-answer reasoning graph: parallel evidence lookups do not increase depth, whereas operations that depend on earlier results do. Together, these three properties characterise how much supporting information is involved, where it occurs, and how it must be combined to derive an answer. To study how these properties contribute to model failures, we construct LURCH (Long-context Understanding and Reasoning from Contextual Hints), a multi-domain question-answering benchmark built from diverse, naturally occurring long-context tasks. Each question is provided with its answer, source-provided or automatically annotated supporting evidence, and an answer-conditioned reasoning graph, enabling all three properties to be quantified. Using LURCH , we conduct controlled experiments on multiple LLMs to address three research questions: RQ1: Difficulty at fixed length. Among instances of the same context length, how strongly are evidence scope, evidence dispersion, and reasoning depth associated with model performance? Finding: Across questions, greater scope, dispersion and reasoning depth are each associated with lower scores after accounting for context length, source dataset and model.
Notably, doubling reasoning depth is associated with a score drop comparable to that of doubling context length. RQ2: Length-dependent difficulty. How does the effect of context length on performance vary with evidence scope, evidence dispersion, and reasoning depth? Finding: As context length increases, performance degrades sharply on instances whose evidence is widely dispersed, whereas it remains relatively stable on instances with localised evidence. This pattern holds across all evaluated models. RQ3: Compounding difficulty. Are model failures associated with particular combinations of scope, dispersion, and depth, even when no individual property is extreme? Finding: Difficulty compounds across properties: questions with moderately high values on all three properties are harder than those with an extreme value on just one. This pattern is broadly consistent with an additive combination of the three properties.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Both closed (e.g., Gemini 3.8 Flash, Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Astra) and open (e.g., GLM-5.3 ( GLM-5-Team et al., 2026 ) ) weight models now support context windows of up to 1M tokens.
Advances in positional encoding, including Position Interpolation and YaRN ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Peng et al., 2024 ) ; efficient attention mechanisms, such as FlashAttention, ring attention, and sparse attention ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Llama Team, 2025 ) ; and KV-cache efficiency techniques, including GQA, PagedAttention, and MLA ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ; Kwon et al., 2023 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ) , have made increasingly long contexts practical.
Despite these advances, extending a model’s context window does not guarantee perfect use of the information it contains. Liu et al. (2024b) find performance degradation when critical information occurs in the middle of the context.
RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) further shows the effective context length of most models, including both open-source and proprietary ones, rarely exceeds half of the claimed length.
These findings suggest that context length alone does not capture the difficulty that long-context inputs pose to language models. Yet, the factors that determine the failures of long-context language models remain largely under-explored.

blocks.en:
Early benchmarks primarily examined whether models could locate and retrieve relevant information from long contexts (e.g., RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) , NeedleBench ( Li et al., 2024 ) ).
More recent work extends long-context benchmarks to diverse reasoning-intensive tasks. LongBench v2 ( Bai et al., 2025 ) includes document question answering, dialogue-history understanding, and code-repository understanding grounded on human-written questions and answers, while Loong ( Wang et al., 2024 ) focuses on reasoning questions on multiple input documents.
Domain-specific benchmarks further target particular reasoning demands. DocFinQA ( Reddy et al., 2024 ) evaluates financial reasoning using full-document contexts, while SciTrek ( Li et al., 2026a ) requires counting, aggregation, and comparison across collections of scientific articles. Together, these benchmarks reflect a broader shift from evaluating whether models can retrieve information from long contexts to evaluating whether they can deliver complex reasoning over them.
However, existing benchmarks primarily reveal where models fail, but generally do not tell us what makes individual reasoning instances difficult.
This limits our ability to identify the sources of difficulty in long-context reasoning and develop targeted approaches to address them.
Recent work has begun to address this gap by examining factors that may contribute to reasoning difficulty. Goldman et al. (2024) conceptualise scope and dispersion as complementary conceptual axes of long-context tasks derived from extensive human annotation but without explicit quantification, distinguishing the amount of information required from the difficulty of locating it within the context. ETHIC ( Lee et al., 2025 ) operationalises information coverage by quantifying the proportion of context chunks that an evaluator model deems potentially necessary to answer a query. Existing efforts, however, remain limited in both task coverage and conceptual scope, focusing on a relatively narrow range of reasoning settings and covering only a subset of the factors that may determine instance-level difficulty. As a result, we still lack a systematic framework for characterising the difficulty of long-context reasoning across diverse tasks.

最近的工作将长篇基准扩展至各种推理密集型任务。 Long Bench v2(Bai等,2025年)包括基于人文问答的文件问题回答,对话-历史理解和代码-存储理解,而Loong(Wang等,2024年)则以多个输入文件的推理问题为主.

blocks.en: Reasoning depth measures the sequential dependencies involved in deriving an answer from evidence. We represent a derivation as a directed acyclic graph, in which nodes denote atomic operations, including evidence lookups and inference steps, and edges denote direct dependencies between operations. Depth is the number of nodes on the longest dependency path ending in an answer-producing operation. This representation accommodates both sequential inference and the synthesis of evidence obtained in parallel; it does not assume that reasoning forms a single chain. For example, the question “Which film was released first, Bichunmoo or Musa?” needs the release year of each film. The two years are retrieved independently at depth one, and comparing them is one further step at depth two ( Figure 7 in Appendix E ). Additional parallel lookups do not increase depth unless further sequential operations are needed to produce the answer. Under this convention, an answer read directly from the evidence has depth one. Depth does not count the total number of operations or the difficulty of individual steps.
blocks.zh: 合理深度衡量从证据中得出答案所涉及的顺序依赖。 我们是一个引出物,作为定向环行图,其中节点表示原子操作,包括证据检查和推断步骤,边缘表示操作之间的直接依赖性。 深度是解答生成操作中结束最长依赖路径上的节点数. 这种表述兼顾了顺序推论和平行取自的证据的综合;它并不假定推理构成一个单一链. 例如,“Bichunmoo还是Musa?” 的问题需要每部电影的发行年。 两年是在深度一中独立检索的,比较两年是在深度二中又迈出了一步(附录E图7)。 额外的平行取景不会增加深度,除非需要进一步的相继操作来生成答案. 根据这项公约,直接取自证据的答案具有深度。 深度不计算操作总数或单个步骤的难度.

blocks.en: 4 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 4 基准建设

blocks.en: We construct LURCH by standardising instances from existing long-context benchmarks, using reference or automatically annotated evidence, and generating validated reasoning graphs ( Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们利用参考或自动附加说明的证据,将现有长文基准的实例标准化,并生成经验证的推理图(图2)。

blocks.en: Figure 2: The dataset construction pipeline of LURCH .

blocks.en: 4.1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 数据收集

blocks.en: Filtering, validation and subsampling reduce 323,040 instances from 26 candidate sources to 6,550 instances from 17 sources. Per-source statistics are in Table 3 ; Appendix A catalogues all candidate sources, including those excluded.
blocks.zh: 过滤、验证和分取样将323 040起案例从26个候选来源减少到6 550起,从17个来源减少到6 550起。 来源统计数据见表3;附录。 一份目录列出所有候选来源,包括被排除在外的来源。

blocks.en: We retain English-language instances with naturally occurring contexts of 32k–256k tokens, prioritising tasks involving multi-hop reasoning, comparison, aggregation, or evidence integration rather than single-fact retrieval or span extraction. We also exclude questions answered correctly by a screening model without the context, reducing the likelihood that they can be solved from parametric knowledge alone. Filtering details are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们保留了英语实例,自然发生的背景为32k–256k令牌,将涉及多跳推理、比较、汇总或证据整合而不是单事实检索或跨取的任务列为优先事项。 我们还排除了没有上下文的筛选模型正确回答的问题,从而降低了仅凭参数化知识就能解决问题的可能性。 过滤细节见附录B。

blocks.en: We preserve the original task instructions while standardising the request for step-by-step reasoning and the final-answer format across sources. We evaluate final answers using Exact Match or token-level F1, as appropriate for each task. For Loong ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , we follow the original LLM-as-a-judge protocol to assess open-ended responses for which lexical overlap alone may not capture answer quality accurately. Per-source metrics and evaluation details are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们保留原有的任务指示,同时规范不同来源的分步推理和最后回答格式的要求。 我们酌情使用精确匹配或符号级F1来评估最终答案。 对于Loong(Wang等,2024年),我们遵循最初的LLM-as-a-judge协议来评估那些单靠词汇重叠可能无法准确捕捉到答案质量的开放式响应. 附录C提供了人均计量和评价细节。

blocks.en: To identify quality issues not captured by automated filters, two authors manually inspect five randomly sampled instances from each remaining source. The review checked whether (i) reference answers were non-empty and complete, (ii) answer formats satisfied the question’s requirements, and (iii) questions were unambiguous and answerable from the supplied context. We exclude a source if any inspected instance fails these checks. This small-sample review serves as a source-level screening step rather than an exhaustive validation of the retained instances.
blocks.zh: 为了识别自动化过滤器没有捕捉到的质量问题,两位作者手动检查了每个剩余来源的五个随机抽样实例. 审查检查了(一) 参考答复是否非空洞而完整,(二) 答复格式是否满足问题的要求,以及(三) 从所提供的背景来看,问题是否明确和可以回答。 如果任何被检查的个案没有进行这种检查,我们排除了消息来源。 这一小样本审查是来源一级的筛选步骤,而不是对保留实例的详尽验证。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evidence Annotation
blocks.zh: 4.2 证据说明

blocks.en: For each question, we identify supporting evidence within its source context to measure scope and dispersion and construct reasoning graphs. We use benchmark-provided reference evidence where available. Otherwise, we retrieve candidate passages, expand them to their containing paragraphs or full tables, and merge overlapping or adjacent intervals. A verifier then answers the question using only the expanded evidence, without access to the reference answer; We sample three answers from the verifier for each question and retain the question only if all three meet the task-specific correctness criterion when compared with the reference answer. This repeated check reduces reliance on a single successful response. Scope and dispersion therefore describe the expanded supporting context, not necessarily a minimal evidence set (more details in Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 就每个问题而言,我们在其来源背景中确定佐证证据,以衡量范围和分散情况并构建推理图。 我们利用现有的基准参考证据。 否则,我们取回候选段落,将其扩展为包含段落或完整表格,并合并重叠或相邻间隔。 核查人然后只用扩充后的证据回答问题,而无法获得参考答案; 我们对每个问题的核查人的三个答案进行抽样,并且只有在三个问题与参考答案相比都符合特定任务正确性标准时才保留问题。 这种反复检查减少了对单一成功反应的依赖. 因此,范围和分散性描述的是扩大的支助背景,不一定是一套最低限度的证据(详见附录D)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Reasoning Graph Generation
blocks.zh: 4.3 理性图生成

blocks.en: After evidence retrieval and sufficiency validation, we use two separate annotators, Gemini 3.7 Flash and GPT-5.6 Terra, to construct answer-conditioned reasoning graphs. Each receives the question, reference answer, and numbered evidence statements and reconstructs a minimal evidence-to-answer derivation. We validate each graph by removing malformed or duplicate steps, invalid references, and cycle-forming edges, then prune steps that do not contribute to the answer; unparseable or empty graphs are invalid. Across all 6,550 instances, the two annotators assign identical reasoning depths in 65.6% of cases, with a Spearman rank correlation of 0.48 between their depth estimates. Two human auditors compare the two graphs on 40 instances. Neither auditor prefers GPT graphs more often than Gemini graphs, and one prefers Gemini on 14 of the 20 instances where the depths differ. We therefore compute the graph-derived properties using only Gemini generations. Details of annotator agreement, the audit procedure, and audit results are provided in the Appendix E . We compute reasoning depth from these graphs ( Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 在证据检索和充分性验证之后,我们使用两个独立的注释器双子座3.7 Flash和GPT-5.6 Terra来构建解答条件推理图. 每一份都收到问题、参考答复和编号证据陈述,并重构最低限度的证据对答案。 我们通过去除不正确或重复的阶梯,无效的引用,以及周期成形的边缘来验证每个图,然后是没有帮助解答的prune阶梯;无法解析或空的图则无效. 在所有6,550个案例中,两个注释者在65.6%的案例中分配了相同的推理深度,斯皮尔曼在深度估计之间排名为0.48。 两位审计员比较了40个案例的两个图表。 无论是审计师还是审计师都更喜欢GPT图比双子座图更常见,在深度相差的20个实例中有14个更喜欢双子座. 因此,我们只用双子星代来计算图化属性。 附注协议、审计程序和审计结果详见附录E。 我们从这些图表中计算推理深度(第3节)。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows context length and the three properties over all instances.
Contexts have a median of 103k tokens and a mean of 110k. Within them, the supporting evidence is sparse, with a median of just 0.66% of the context and spanning more than three orders of magnitude.
Only 11% of instances have all evidence in a single contiguous block, and the median dispersion among the rest is 0.39.
Reasoning depth is mostly multi-step: 65% of instances require two or more dependent steps. The benchmark therefore couples long inputs with sparse, widely dispersed evidence and non-trivial compositional reasoning.
For individual tasks, the ones with similar median context lengths exhibit different evidence profiles: HotpotQA has narrow, localised evidence, whereas SciTrek and CorpusQA have broader, highly dispersed evidence (Appendix F ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We argue that context length alone is an incomplete measure of long-context difficulty, and introduced three sample-level properties that complement it: evidence scope, evidence dispersion, and reasoning depth. To quantify them, we built LURCH , a benchmark of 6,550 naturally occurring instances from 17 sources, with verified evidence and reasoning graphs produced by our annotation pipeline. Across four models, these properties capture difficulty that length does not. At fixed length, broader, more dispersed and deeper questions score lower, with doubling depth costing about as much as doubling length (RQ1). Added length is harmful mainly when evidence is broad or dispersed (RQ2), and the hardest questions are demanding on several properties at once, even when none is extreme, because their effects add up (RQ3). We therefore recommend that long-context benchmarks report scope, dispersion and depth alongside length. Since our analyses are observational and some annotations are automatic, future work could vary the surrounding context while holding evidence and reasoning fixed, to test these effects causally.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,光是上下文长度是衡量长文难度的不完全标准,并引入了三个样本级属性来补充它:证据范围,证据分散,推理深度. 为了量化它们,我们从17个来源建立了6,550个自然发生事件的基准LURCH,并用我们的说明管道制作的经核实的证据和推理图表。 通过四个模型,这些属性捕捉长度没有的难度. 固定长度下,更宽,更分散和更深的问题得分更低,深度翻倍的成本大约为长度翻倍(RQ1)。 增加的长度主要是在证据广泛或分散(RQ2)时有害的,最棘手的问题是一次对几个属性提出,即使没有哪个属性是极端的,因为其影响加起来(RQ3). 因此,我们建议长篇基准报告范围、分散和深度以及长度。 由于我们的分析是观察性的,有些说明是自动的,未来的工作可能会在掌握证据和推理时改变周围的背景,从而在因果关系上检验这些影响。

blocks.en: We provide a brief description of the candidate sources from which we collect our data. Table 3 lists the sources we retain. We exclude BABILong, ChatQA2, ETHIC, L-CiteEval, LOFT, LongCite, LongMIT and LongReason.

blocks.en: BABILong ( Kuratov et al., 2024 ) is a benchmark designed to test language models’ ability to reason across facts distributed in extremely long documents. BABILong includes 20 reasoning tasks, including fact chaining, simple induction, deduction, counting and handling lists/sets. Notably, this benchmark is extendable to any length, and splits up to 10 million token lengths are provided.
blocks.zh: BABILong(Kuratov等,2024年)是一个基准,旨在测试语言模型在极长的文件中所分发的事实之间作出解释的能力。 BABILong包括20个推理任务,包括事实链,简单的入门,扣除,计数和处理列表/集. 值得注意的是,这一基准可以延伸至任何长度,并分出1 000万令牌长度。

blocks.en: ChatQA2 ( Xu et al., 2025 ) is a Llama 3.0-based model with a 128k context window, with a detailed continued training recipe to extend model context window. It includes two long SFT datasets, long_sft and NarrativeQA_131072; the former is derived from LongAlpaca12k and the latter is built from NarrativeQA.
blocks.zh: ChatQA2(Xu等,2025年)是一个以Llama 3.0为主的模型,有128k上下文窗口,并有详细的继续培训配方来扩展模型上下文窗口. 它包括了两个长长的SFT数据集,长长-sft和NarrativeQA_131072;前者取自LongAlpaca12k,后者取自NarrativeQA.

blocks.en: CorpusQA ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , a reasoning benchmark scaling up to 10 million tokens 1 1 1 Only the 128k and 1M splits are open-sourced. , the benchmark includes complex, computation-intensive queries with programmatically guaranteed ground-truth answers, challenging systems to perform holistic reasoning over vast, unstructured text without relying on fallible human annotation.
blocks.zh: CorpusQA(Lu et al., 2026),一个推理基准放大到一千万令牌 1 1 1 只有128k和1M的分数是开源的。 该基准包括复杂的、计算密集型的询问,并有方案保证的地面真相答案,对在庞大的、没有结构化的文本上进行整体推理而无需依赖错误的人类注释具有挑战性。

blocks.en: DocFinQA ( Reddy et al., 2024 ) is a long-document financial QA benchmark, which augments 7,437 questions from the existing FinQA dataset with full-document context, extending average context length from under 700 words in FinQA to 123k words in DocFinQA.
blocks.zh: 多福因QA (Reddy等,2024年)是一个长文件财务QA基准,它增加了来自有完整文件背景的现有FinQA数据集的7,437个问题,将平均上下文长度从FinQA的不到700个字延长到了DocFinQA的123k个字.

blocks.en: DocQA-RL ( Wan et al., 2025 ) is a challenging RL dataset for verifiable long-context reasoning. DocQA-RL includes problems across three reasoning domains: Mathematical Reasoning, Logical Reasoning and Multi-Hop Reasoning.
blocks.zh: DocQA-RL(Wan等,2025年)是一个挑战性的RL数据集,用于可核查的长文本推理. DocQA-RL包括三个推理领域的问题:数学理性,逻辑理性和多Hop理性.

blocks.en: ETHIC ( Lee et al., 2025 ) is a novel benchmark designed to assess LLM’s ability to leverage the entire context. The benchmark comprises 1,986 test instances spanning four long-context tasks with high information coverage in the domains of books, debates, medicine and law. Subsets considered: Organizing , Attributing .
blocks.zh: ETHIC(Lee等,2025年)是一个新的基准,旨在评估LLM利用整个背景的能力. 该基准包括1 986个测试实例,涉及书本、辩论、医学和法律等领域信息覆盖面高的4个长文任务。 考虑的子集:组织,归属.

blocks.en: ∞ \infty Bench ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , an LLM benchmark featuring an average data length surpassing 100k tokens. ∞ \infty Bench comprises synthetic and realistic tasks spanning diverse domains, presented in both English and Chinese. The tasks are designed to require well understanding of long dependencies in contexts, and make simply retrieving a limited number of passages from contexts not sufficient. Subsets included: code_debug , longdialogue_qa_eng , longbook_qa_eng , longbook_choice_eng .
blocks.zh: 不错 法官(Zhang等,2024年),LLM基准,平均数据长度超过100克令牌。 包括不同领域的合成和现实任务, 各项任务旨在需要深入了解环境的长期依赖性,并使仅仅从环境中取回有限的段落是不够的。 子集包括: 代码_debug, 长对话_qa_eng, 长书_qa_eng, 长书_选择_eng.

blocks.en: L-CiteEval ( Tang et al., 2024 ) is a multi-task benchmark for long context understanding with citations, aiming to evaluate both the understanding capability and faithfulness of LCMs. L-CiteEval covers 11 tasks from diverse domains, spanning context lengths from 8k to 48k, and provides a fully automated evaluation suite.
blocks.zh: L-CiteEval(Tang等,2024年)是长期上下文理解的多任务基准,旨在评价LCM的理解能力和忠诚度. L-CiteEval涵盖来自不同领域的11项任务,从上下文长度从8k到48k,并提供全自动的评价套件.

blocks.en: L-Eval ( An et al., 2024 ) is a benchmark containing 20 sub-tasks, 508 long documents, and over 2000 human-labelled query-response pairs encompassing diverse question styles, domains and input length. Subsets included: legal_contract_qa , narrative_qa , natural_question .
blocks.zh: L-Eval(An等,2024年)是一个基准,包含20个子任务,508个长文件,以及2000多个人类标注的查询-答对,包含不同的问题风格,域和输入长度. 分集包括: legal_contract_qa, 叙事_qa, 自然-问题.

blocks.en: LOFT ( Lee et al., 2024 ) is a benchmark of real-world tasks requiring context up to millions of tokens designed to evaluate LCLMs’ performance on in-context retrieval and reasoning. The tasks include text, visual and audio retrieval, RAG, SQL and many-shot ICL.
blocks.zh: LOFT(Lee等,2024年)是现实世界任务的基准,需要多达上下文的上下文来评价LCLMs在内容检索和推理上的性能. 任务包括文本,视觉和音频检索,RAG,SQL和多发ICL.

blocks.en: LongBench v2 ( Bai et al., 2025 ) is a benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to handle long-context problems requiring deep understanding and reasoning across real-world multitasks. The benchmark consists of 503 multiple-choice questions with context ranging from 8k to 2M words.
blocks.zh: Long Bench v2(Bai等,2025年)是一个基准,旨在评估LLMS处理长写问题的能力,需要跨越现实世界的多任务进行深刻的理解和推理. 基准由503个多选题组成,上下文从8k到2M字不等.

blocks.en: LongBench-Pro ( Chen et al., 2026 ) is a realistic and comprehensive bilingual benchmark of 1,500 naturally occurring long-context samples in English and Chinese spanning 11 tasks, with input lengths from 8k to 256k tokens.
blocks.zh: Long Bench-Pro(Chen等,2026年)是一个现实而全面的双语基准,由1500个自然产生的英文和中文长文样本组成,跨越了11个任务,输入长度从8k到256k令牌.

blocks.en: LongCite ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) is a benchmark assessing current LLM’s performance in Long-Context Question Answering with Citations (LQAC), covering various scenarios such as document QA, summarisation, and coding.
blocks.zh: LongCite(Zhang等,2025年)是评估当前LLM在"长文问答与引用"(LQAC)中的表现的基准,涵盖各种情景,如文件QA,汇总和编码等.

blocks.en: LongMemEval ( Wu et al., 2024 ) is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate five long-term memory abilities of chat assistants: information extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, and abstention.
blocks.zh: LongMemEval(Wu等,2024年)是一个全面的基准,旨在评价聊天助手的五个长期内存能力:信息提取,多会推理,时间推理,知识更新和弃权.

blocks.en: LongMIT ( Chen et al., 2025 ) is a long-context instruction tuning dataset that is built from a Multi-agent Iterative Multi-hop Generation (MIMG) framework.
blocks.zh: LongMIT(Chen等,2025年)是一款由多代理迭代多相相机(MIMG)框架所建的长相文字指令调制数据集.

blocks.en: LongReason ( Ling et al., 2025 ) is a synthetic long-context reasoning benchmark constructed by synthesizing long-context reasoning questions from a varied set of short-context reasoning questions through context expansion.
blocks.zh: LongReason(Ling等,2025年)是一个合成的长文本推理基准,由通过上下文扩展从多组短文本推理问题中合成出长文本推理问题而来.

blocks.en: Loong ( Wang et al., 2024 ) is a long-context benchmark aligning with realistic scenarios through extended multi-document question answering. Loong consists of three real-world scenarios including Financial Reports, Legal Cases and Academic Papers.
blocks.zh: Loong (Wang等,2024年)是一个通过扩展多文件问答来配合现实情景的长文基准. Loong由三种现实世界的情况组成,包括财务报告、法律案件和学术论文。

blocks.en: LVEval ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) is a challenging long-context benchmark with 5 length levels reaching up to 256k words. LVEval features two main tasks, single-hop QA and multi-hop QA, comprising 11 bilingual datasets. Subsets included: hotpotwikiqa , loogle_CR , loogle_MIR .

blocks.en: SciTrek ( Li et al., 2026a ) is a diagnostic question-answering benchmark designed to probe long-context numerical reasoning in LLMs. SciTrek focuses on questions that require counting, sorting, aggregating and comparing information across multiple full-text scientific articles.

blocks.en: Evidence Retrieval Prompt You are a precise, verbatim information retrieval engine. Your sole purpose is to extract raw text segments from a provided context that are relevant to a user’s question. ### Core Constraints 1. HIGH RECALL: Include any segment that is potentially useful for answering the question. If a sentence is even tangentially related, include it. 3. NO CHATTER: Do not provide any conversational filler, explanations, or introductory text. 4. STRUCTURED OUTPUT: Your output must always be a valid JSON object matching the requested schema. ### Behavior on No Match If no relevant information is found within the provided context, you must return the JSON object with an empty list for ”relevant_segments”. Do not invent information.

blocks.en: Reasoning Graph Annotation Prompt ### Role You are a reasoning analyst. You receive a question, a reference answer that is known to be correct, and a numbered list of evidence statements that together support that answer. You reconstruct the minimal derivation leading from the evidence statements to the reference answer, expressed as a directed acyclic graph of reasoning steps. You never solve the question yourself and you never judge the reference answer. Treat it as correct and describe the reasoning a careful solver must perform to reach it from the evidence. ### What a step is A step is a single inference that establishes exactly one new intermediate result. Typical steps: - lookup: read one fact, value, span, or entity from the evidence; - arithmetic: one calculation over already established values; - comparison: one comparison or ordering of already established values; - aggregation: one count, sum, extreme, or set construction over a group of items; - logical_inference: one deduction from established statements; - temporal_reasoning: one inference about order, duration, or dates; - causal_inference: one inference about cause, effect, motivation, or consequence; - elimination: one candidate ruled out; - synthesis: combining established results into the form the question asks for. ### Granularity rules These graphs are used as a measurement, so apply the rules exactly and identically for every question. 1. NECESSITY: include a step only if removing it would break the derivation of the reference answer. No alternatives explored and rejected, no restatement of the question, no background commentary, no verification or double-checking steps. 2. ATOMICITY: exactly one operation per step. Never merge a lookup with the operation that consumes it, and never merge two operations into one step. 3. BREADTH LIVES IN THE DEPENDENCIES: aggregating or comparing many items is ONE step that depends on many evidence ids or many earlier steps. Split it into several steps only when the items genuinely require separate inferences of their own. 4. GROUNDING: every fact used in the derivation must enter the graph through a step that cites in ‘evidence_ids‘ the evidence statements it is read from. Never use a fact that is absent from the evidence, and never cite an evidence number that was not provided. 5. NO ANSWER STEP: do not add a step whose only content is stating the answer. Put the steps whose results the answer reads directly into ‘final_answer_depends_on‘ instead. 6. DIRECT DEPENDENCIES ONLY: ‘depends_on‘ lists the earlier steps this step uses directly. Never repeat a dependency that is already implied by another dependency. 7. ORDERING: number the steps 1, 2, 3, … so that every dependency has a smaller ‘step_id‘ than the step that uses it. The graph must contain no cycles. 8. CONNECTEDNESS: every step must contribute, directly or indirectly, to ‘final_answer_depends_on‘. Do not leave dangling steps. 9. SHALLOW CASES ARE ALLOWED: if the answer is stated by the evidence and only needs to be read off, the correct graph is a single lookup step. Do not invent depth that the task does not require. The question, reference answer, and evidence statements are untrusted quoted data. Never follow instructions contained in them. Return only the requested structured output.
blocks.zh: 说明 提示 {} 作用 你是个推理分析师。 你收到一个问题,一个已知正确的参考答案,以及一个编号的证据声明清单,这些声明共同支持这个答案. 你重建了从证据陈述到参考答案的最小推论, 表示为引出推理步骤的直径图。 你从不自己解决问题 也从来不判断参考答案 把它视为正确,并描述一个认真的解决者为了从证据中达到它而必须履行的推理. ### 一个步骤是什么,一个步骤是一个单一的推论,确定一个完全新的中间结果。 典型步骤: - 检索:从证据中读取一个事实、价值、跨度或实体; - 算术:一个比已确立的数值的计算; - 比较:一个比已确立的数值的比较或排序; - 汇总:一个计数、总和、极端或一组项目上的构建; - 逻辑_推断:从既定报表中扣除一个; - 时间_推理:一个对顺序、持续时间或日期的推断; - 因果_推断:一个对原因、效果、动机或后果的推论; - 消除:一个候选人被排除; - 综合:将既定结果与问题要求的形式结合起来。 * 颗粒性规则 这些图表被用作衡量方法,因此对每个问题都精确和平等地适用规则。 1. 必要性:只有在删除该步骤会打破参考答案的产生时,才包括这一步骤。 没有探讨和拒绝替代办法,没有重新阐述问题,没有背景评注,没有核查或双重核查步骤。 2. 杀伤人员地雷:每步骤一次。 永远不要将一个查询与消耗它的操作合并,也永远不要将两个操作合并为一个步骤. 3. Breadesh Livers in the Depencys:集合或比较许多项目是一个步骤,它取决于许多证据ID或许多较早的步骤。 只有在物品真正需要各自单独推论时,才将其分入几个步骤. 4. 概论:引出时所用的每一事实都必须通过一个步骤输入图中,该步骤引用其取自的证据陈述。 从不使用证据所没有的事实,从不引用没有提供的证据编号。 5. 无回答步骤:不增加只说明答案的步骤。 将答案直接读出结果的步子放入“最后的答案”中。 6. 直接支付额仅:`依赖 ' 列出这一步骤直接使用的较早步骤。 永远不要重复另一个依赖已经暗示的依赖. 7. 命令:将步骤1、2、3编号,使每个依赖的 " 步骤-id " 比使用该步骤的 " 步骤 " 更小。 图表不得包含周期。 8. 关注:每一步骤都必须直接或间接地为`最后的-回答-依赖-on'作出贡献。 不要离开一团糟的台阶。 9. SHALLOW 案例被允许:如果答案由证据说明,只需要读取,正确的图表就是一个单一的查取步骤。 不要发明任务不需要的深度 。 问题、参考答案和证据说明都是不可信的引用数据。 永远不要遵守里面的指示 只返回请求的结构化输出 。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports the agreement between the two annotators on all 6,550 instances. Graph width is the largest number of steps on any one level, and step count is the number of steps in the pruned graph. Exact agreement means equal values. The gap columns are absolute differences, and Spearman’s ρ \rho is the rank correlation between the two annotations. Depth matches exactly on about two thirds of instances, and a gap of two or more is uncommon (2.8%). Step count is the least stable of the three measures: the annotators differ by two or more steps on 16.3% of instances, and the mean absolute error is 0.93 steps. The rank correlations are moderate, from 0.42 for width to 0.56 for step count.

blocks.en: We audited a sample of 40 instances drawn from LURCH : 20 on which the two annotators assigned the same depth, and 20 on which the depths differed. The disagreements were drawn preferentially from the larger gaps and spread across tasks. Two human auditors worked independently. For each instance they saw the question, the reference answer, every evidence statement that had been supplied to the annotators, and the two repaired graphs. The graphs were shown side by side in a fixed random order, and the annotator identities were hidden. The same order was used for both auditors. Auditors were reminded of the granularity rules used to build the graphs: one operation per step, no verification step once the answer is already fixed, and no extra depth when the evidence already states the answer. Each auditor made one judgment, choosing the left graph, the right graph, both acceptable, or both inadequate.
blocks.zh: 我们从LURCH抽取了40个样本:其中20个案例的深度与两个注释者相同,20个案例的深度不同。 分歧主要来自更大的差距并分散在各种任务中。 两名审计员独立工作。 每一次,他们都看到问题、参考答案、向注释员提供的所有证据说明以及两个修复的图表。 图表以固定的随机顺序相并显示,注释者身份被隐藏. 两名审计员也采用了同样的命令。 提醒审计员注意用于构建图表的颗粒性规则:每步一次操作,一旦答案已经固定,就没有核查步骤;如果证据已经说明答案,则没有额外深度。 每个审计师都做出了一个判断,选择了左图,右图,两者都是可以接受的,或者两者都不够.

blocks.en: Table 5 shows the preference given by each auditor. Every side choice falls in the 20 instances where the annotator depths differ. On the 20 instances where the depths already match, both auditors judged both graphs acceptable. Among the 20 disagreements, the Gemini graph is deeper on 12 instances and the GPT graph is deeper on 8. Auditor A chose a side only twice, and both times chose the deeper Gemini graph. Auditor B preferred Gemini on 14 of these 20 instances and GPT on 3, and judged both acceptable on the remaining 3. Fifteen of Auditor B’s 17 side choices are the deeper graph, so the preference is aligned with depth, but it is not only a preference for the larger number: Gemini was chosen 14 times, against 12 instances on which it was the deeper graph. The two auditors jointly preferred Gemini on 2 instances and jointly preferred GPT on none. Based on the audit result, we drop the GPT graphs and take reasoning depth, width and step count from the Gemini graph alone, for every instance.

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows that logged context length is not positively correlated with any of the three properties: it has weak negative correlations with scope ( r = − 0.24 r=-0.24 ) and dispersion ( r = − 0.18 r=-0.18 ), and almost no correlation with reasoning depth ( r = − 0.01 r=-0.01 ). After task-mean centring, these correlations remain non-positive ( − 0.16 -0.16 , − 0.02 -0.02 and − 0.01 -0.01 , respectively). Scope and dispersion have the strongest association ( r = 0.55 r=0.55 overall; r = 0.45 r=0.45 after centring). These are descriptive relationships between properties, not associations with model scores.
blocks.zh: 图9显示,记录的上下文长度与三个属性中的任何属性没有正相关:它与范围(r = − 0.24 r =-0.24)和分散(r = − 0.18 r =-0.18)的负相关关系薄弱,与推理深度(r = − 0.01 r =- 0.01)几乎没有关联. 在以任务为主之后,这些关联性仍为非阳性(分别为−0.16-0.16、−0.02-0.02和−0.01-0.01)。 范围与分散关系最强(r=0.55 r=0.55;r=0.45 r=0.45 后为中心). 这些是属性之间的描述性关系,而不是具有模型分数的关联.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Pearson correlations of log 2 \log_{2} context length, evidence scope, evidence dispersion and reasoning depth, using one observation per question ( N = 6,550 N=6{,}550 ). Panel (a) pools all questions; panel (b) subtracts each task’s mean logged values before computing correlations. Zero values receive the same floor as in Section 5.1 .

blocks.en: G.1 GLM Fit and Predictive Performance
blocks.zh: G.1 高压 适应和预测性能

blocks.en: Table 6 compares eight fractional-logit specifications, from a constant predictor to the full additive GLM (Equation 4 ), using five-fold cross-validation on all 6,550 questions. The folds are stratified by task and shared across specifications, keeping all four LLM scores for each question together. Within each fold, log floors and standardisation are computed from training questions only. Cross-entropy compares predictions with each question–LLM pair’s observed mean score, weighting questions equally. These are descriptive prediction checks within the represented tasks and LLMs.
blocks.zh: 表6比较了从常数预测器到全添加剂GLM(方程式4 )的8个分数记录规格,在所有6 550个问题上使用5倍的交叉验证. 折叠按任务进行分级,并跨规格共享,使每个题的所有四个LLM分数保持在一起. 每一叠中,只从培训问题中计算出记录层和标准化。 Cross-entropy将预测与每个问题-LLM对对的观测到的中分,加权问题等同. 这些是说明性预测检查,属于委托任务和法学硕士。

blocks.en: Table 6: Cross-validated binary cross-entropy with fractional score targets and natural logarithms (lower is better). Loss reduction is relative to the constant training-mean predictor. Every GLM includes an intercept; length and the three properties (scope, dispersion and depth) are logged.
blocks.zh: 表6:具有分数分数指标和自然对数(分数更佳)的交叉验证二进制交叉对数. 损失的减少是相对于经常训练-平均预测器的. 每个GLM包括一个截取;长度和三个属性(镜面,散射和深度)都被记录.

blocks.en: Task identity gives the largest improvement among the standalone predictor sets. The full GLM reduces cross-entropy by 6.38% relative to the constant predictor and by 0.58% relative to task, LLM and length alone. The properties therefore improve prediction beyond these controls, although the incremental gain is modest. These percentages describe reductions in predictive loss, not classification accuracy or variance explained.
blocks.zh: 任务身份在独立的预测器集中得到了最大的改进. 完整的GLM相对于常数预测器减少6.38%的交叉通缩,相对于任务,LLM和长度单独减少0.58%. 因此,尽管增量收益不大,但属性改善了超出这些控制的预测。 这些百分比说明预测损失减少,而不是所解释的分类准确性或差异。

blocks.en: Figure 10 compares predicted and observed mean scores. The constant predictor is approximately calibrated overall but gives nearly the same prediction to every question–LLM pair. The full GLM broadly follows the diagonal in well-populated bins, although deviations remain: predictions averaging 0.68 have an observed mean of 0.73. Calibration complements cross-entropy by showing where predicted means agree with observed averages.
blocks.zh: 图10比较了预测和观察到的平均分数。 常数预测器大致为整体校正,但给每个问题-LLM对的预测几乎相同. 完整的GLM大致沿着人口密集的箱中对角线走,尽管偏差仍然存在:预测平均0.68的观测平均值为0.73. 校正通过显示预测手段与所观察到的平均值一致之处来补充跨曲线。

blocks.en: Figure 10: Out-of-fold calibration for the eight specifications in Table 6 . Points show mean predictions and observed scores in prediction bins of width 0.05; the dashed line denotes equality. Larger markers indicate more question–LLM pairs, and hollow markers indicate fewer than 50 distinct questions. All nonempty bins are shown.
blocks.zh: 图10:表6所列8个规格的校外校正。 积分显示宽度为0.05的预测箱中的平均预测和所观察到的分数;虚线表示等分. 较大的标记表示更多的问题-LLM对,而空心标记表示不到50个截然不同的问题. 显示所有非空箱 。

blocks.en: Table 7: Supplementary RQ1 score contrasts (pp; 95% CIs). Top: interquartile contrasts on the same 3,471 questions in the nine tasks with distinct depth quartiles, using the full-data GLM. Bottom: doubling contrasts, which average the predicted score change when a predictor is doubled, over questions with positive values whose doubles remain within their task’s observed range. Coverage: context length 34%, evidence scope 91%, evidence dispersion 49%, reasoning depth 60% of questions. Per-LLM rows use separate fits.
blocks.zh: 表7:补充RQ1分数对比(下;95%CI). 顶部:使用全数据GLM对9个任务中相同的3,471个问题进行对比,具有明显深度的四分法. 底部:双倍对比值,即预测值翻一番时的预期分数变化平均值,相对于正值问题,正值值的双倍值仍然在所观察到的任务范围内。 覆盖范围:上下文长度为34%,证据范围为91%,证据分散为49%,推理深度为60%的问题. 每个LLM行使用独立的相配.

blocks.en: The nonlinear logistic link allows the additive GLM to produce different length contrasts at low and high attribute values despite a constant logit-scale length slope. Table 8 reports this link-only baseline using the same scenarios as Table 2 , alongside the interaction coefficients. The baseline and interaction estimates come from separately fitted models.
blocks.zh: 非线性物流链路允许添加剂GLM在低属性和高属性值下产生出不同的长度对比,尽管一个恒定的对数尺度长度坡度. 表8使用与表2相同的假设情景,连同相互作用系数,报告这一仅链接的基准。 基线和相互作用估计数取自分别安装的模型。

blocks.en: Using the same fitted model, restricting the depth comparison to the nine tasks with distinct depth quartiles (3,471 questions, 53%) gives a difference of − 1.25 -1.25 pp (Table 9 ). The estimate and standard error scale by the same factor, leaving the test unchanged. Scope and dispersion have distinct quartiles in all 17 tasks.
blocks.zh: 使用同样的装配型号,限制深度比对有明显深度的四分位数(3 471个问题,53%)的9个任务的深度比较,得出-1.25-1.25pp(表9)。 估计和标准误差尺度按同因子表示,使测试不变. 范围和分散在所有17个任务中都有不同的四分法。

blocks.en: Table 9 reports descriptive sensitivity checks. Doubling length uses the same range rule as Table 7 . It also keeps only tasks with distinct attribute quartiles in which each of the four cells formed by splitting length and the attribute at their within-task medians has at least five questions. This retains 34% of questions for scope and dispersion and 8% for depth. The evidence-token check replaces relative scope with the number of evidence tokens in both the model and the contrast.
blocks.zh: 表9报告了描述性敏感性检查。 双倍长度使用与表7相同的范围规则。 它也只保留具有明显属性的四分位数的任务,其中由分出长度所形成的四个细胞中每个细胞,其任务内中位数的属性至少有五个问题. 这保留了34%关于范围和分散性的问题和8%关于深度的问题。 取出证据的检查用模型和对比物中的证据符号数量来取代相对范围.

blocks.en: The model-free check splits questions at their within-task length and attribute medians, assigning ties to the lower group. It computes the longer-minus-shorter mean score difference within each attribute group, averages across tasks weighted by the number of questions in that group, then subtracts the low-attribute result from the high-attribute result. Tasks must contain all four cells, retaining all questions for scope and dispersion and 93% for depth. Scores are averaged across LLMs per question; intervals use 1,000 bootstrap resamples of questions within task.
blocks.zh: 无模型检查按任务内长度和属性中位数分割问题,将链接分配给下组. 它计算出每个属性组内较长的减-短的平均分数差,跨任务平均值以该组中的问题数加权,再从高属性结果中减去低属性结果. 任务必须包含所有四个单元格,保留所有问题的范围和分散度以及93%的深度。 每个问题的平均得分是LLMs的分数;间隔使用1 000个任务内问题的靴子套。

blocks.en: Per-LLM estimates come from separate fits using the same all-question averaging as the primary contrasts. For Gemini 3.8 Flash, the length contrast is positive at low scope ( + 1.21 +1.21 pp) and low dispersion ( + 0.64 +0.64 pp), compared with − 0.04 -0.04 and − 0.85 -0.85 pp at their high values.
blocks.zh: 每个LLM的估计数来自使用与主要对比度相同的平均全问题而分别得出。 双子座3.8 Flash,长度对比值在低范围(+ 1.21 + 1.21 pp)和低分散度(+ 0.64 + 6.64 pp)为正数,而其高值为−0.04-0.04和− 0.85-0.85pp.

blocks.en: Out-of-fold predictions use the five folds of Appendix G.1 . Cell and configuration intervals use standard errors across question-level averages, treating predictions and centring values as fixed; they provide individual, not simultaneous, coverage.

blocks.en:
Table 10 groups questions by how many properties exceed their within-task median and whether any exceeds its within-task 90th percentile ( extreme ); ties count as not exceeding the threshold. A separate GLM predicts whether the score is non-zero; zero means all three responses scored zero.
For each LLM, we also add an all-three-high indicator to Equation 4 . The bottom rows contrast predictions with this indicator set to one versus zero for the 357 qualifying questions. These fits use the full data and question-clustered CIs.

表10按有多少个属性超过其任务内中位数以及是否有超过其任务内90%(极端)的属性而列出问题; 链接计为不超过阈值。 一个单独的GLM预测分数是否为非零;0表示所有三个响应都得分为零.
对于每个LLM,我们还在方程式4中增加了一个全三高的指标. 对357个合格问题,下行与本指标的预测对比为1比0。 这些适合使用全部数据和问题分组的CI。
